scope_of_work_and_exclusions: OUR SCOPE OF WORK (INCLUSIONS)
Demo existing walls at office/corridor fronts to the extent required for new door/frame or glass system openings, 12 locations, +/-101 LF (Plan Note 1)
Demo existing interior partitions shown dashed, +/-175 LF (A1.01 Demolition Plan)
Demolish wall to the extent required for 1-hr construction upgrade, +/-40 LF (REV 1 A1.01 Note 7 / A1.02 Note 4)
Remove existing restroom plumbing fixtures (22 EA per P1.00), toilet partitions and finishes for refurbishment, 2 areas, +/-668 SF (Plan Note 2)
Carefully remove existing data server racks and set aside for owner relocation (Plan Note 3)
Remove existing door, frame and wall to the extent required for new 8'-0" door (Plan Note 5)
Remove existing casework and plumbing fixtures, including REF/DW casework run and 2 sinks, 3 locations, +/-25 LF (Plan Note 6; P1.00)
Remove existing ceiling grid and tile in areas shown, +/-2,371 SF; carefully remove and store acoustic ceiling tiles on site for reuse (Ceiling Note 3, RCP Gen. Note 1)
Remove existing light fixtures as tagged, 75 EA (61 lay-in / 14 linear pendant) (Ceiling Note 1)
Remove all remaining existing 2x4 fluorescent fixtures for LED swap, 78 EA (Addendum #2, Item 1)
Carefully remove existing track light, +/-12'-5", and turn over for relocation (Ceiling Note 2)
Remove existing electrical devices tagged DE (receptacles, data, switches, junction boxes / furniture feeds), 147 EA, including boxes, plates and wiring back to the nearest junction box (E1.00)
Remove existing flex duct at 17 locations and carefully remove existing grilles at 11 locations, set aside for reuse (M1.00 Keynotes 1 & 2)
Remove existing split system AH-1 with associated ductwork, controls and piping within the suite after refrigerant recovery and disconnect by others (M1.00 Keynote 3)
Coordinate salvage of any items with the owner before demolition (Demo Gen. Note 15)
Provide daily clean up of debris generated by demolition activities; leave demolition areas broom clean (Demo Gen. Note 12)
Removal and disposal of all construction debris (C&D) created from this work to an approved landfill accepting this debris per city, county & federal codes & EPA regulations.
All work conforms to state and local code requirements.
ADDED EXCLUSIONS
Existing water heater to remain (Plan Note 4); all work in hatched adjacent Business Group-B tenant areas.
Reinstalling or relocating server racks, track light and grilles; installing new LED fixtures or ceiling tile.

Removal of conduit and wiring beyond the nearest junction box or back to panel / source, panel schedule updates, make-safe and reconnects (E1.00 Notes 2 & 3); abandoned telephone / data cabling (by tenant vendor, Addendum #2 Item 13).
Refrigerant recovery, mechanical / electrical disconnects, capping of trunk ducts and piping, sealing of penetrations, rooftop condensing unit removal and any roof work (M1.00).
Plumbing disconnects, capping and removal of abandoned piping back to main (P1.00 Keynote 1; P0.01 Note 6).
Floor finish removal (carpet tile and vinyl base for new LVT per A6.00) is priced as Alternate No. 1.
Fluorescent fixtures beyond the 153 counted (75 tagged + 78 per Addendum #2) at $45.00 per EA.
